stdout:
LEVELS non-technical vibe-coder pm engineer senior-engineer cto
DEFAULT pm
TECHNICAL LEVEL: non-technical (everyday words, business impact, 2-3 sentences, no paths, SHAs, flags or tool names)
TECHNICAL LEVEL: vibe-coder (product words (app, deploy, repo), what the user sees, 3-4 sentences, no line numbers, SHAs or flags)
TECHNICAL LEVEL: pm (outcome, cost, risk, reversibility, 4-6 sentences; issue and PR links ok, no file paths, SHAs, flags or job names)
TECHNICAL LEVEL: engineer (full technical terms, module names, root cause and trade-offs, 6-10 sentences with a short evidence list)
TECHNICAL LEVEL: senior-engineer (design trade-offs, failure modes, rollout and rollback, file:line evidence, blast radius)
TECHNICAL LEVEL: cto (risk to production and customers, cost, reversibility, the contract at stake; line detail stays in the brief)
